Its build, dated 17 June 1996, the same 1,254,591 bytes, differs from the 19 June one laid out and relocated only in the give-up branch of keys_control_word 0x48bec (the word written 0x000087a0, not 0xffff87a0; the function 4 bytes longer) and one German text at 0xe3814, neither read by the port: exe.c takes either FNV-1a (0x76078ed2, 0x21ef7c33). With every read checked against those bytes, the 1997 CD drew the same pictures in the front end, the four replays (equal at every snapshot) and nine races. Our CD copy has three bits flipped where the 1997 CD's bytes match their neighbours (NOTES §1). The message no longer says 1996.
